description: Answers 'who owns this stock, and what does this manager hold?' Give a query such as a manager name ('BERKSHIRE') or a ticker ('AAPL'). Returns 13F holdings as known on as_of (defaults to today); filings after as_of are hidden. Free keys get the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_13f
title: Get 13F filings
